items.title: Taiwan insists it is independent after Trump warning
items.description: Fresh from his summit in Beijing, the US president warned against a formal declaration of independence by the island.

items.title: Man drives car into pedestrians in Italy, injuring eight
items.description: Eight people were injured, four seriously, before passers-by gave chase and stopped the man.

items.title: Senior IS leader killed in joint operation, US and Nigeria say
items.description: President Donald Trump said the operation eliminated "the most active terrorist in the world", Abu-Bilal al-Minuki.

items.title: Rescue diver dies during search for bodies of Italians who drowned in Maldives caves
items.description: Staff Sgt Mohamed Mahdhee died while diving in the search-and-rescue operation, the Maldives government tells the BBC.

items.title: Whale found dead near Danish island after German rescue operation
items.description: Wildlife experts had previous criticised the operation, saying it would only cause the animal more distress.

items.title: US planning to charge ex-Cuban leader Raúl Castro
items.description: Charges could come as soon as next week in a case reportedly focused on Cuba's downing of two planes in 1996.

items.title: Toddlers among more than 50 schoolchildren kidnapped in Nigeria
items.description: No group has yet claimed responsibility for the attacks, which have devastated Mussa town in Borno state.

items.title: Canadian from hantavirus-hit cruise ship tests positive
items.description: The individual is one of four former passengers on the MV Hondius isolating on Vancouver Island, British Columbia.

items.title: Switzerland to open secret files on Auschwitz 'Angel of Death' Mengele
items.description: Mengele fled Europe after the war but for years there were rumours he spent time in Switzerland.

items.title: Lebanon says six killed in Israeli strike as US announces ceasefire extension
items.description: President Trump announced the truce last month, but Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since then.

items.title: Freight train and bus crash kills at least eight in Bangkok
items.description: Police and rescue officials said the collision sparked a fire that engulfed the bus.

items.title: Man killed by 13ft shark in Western Australia
items.description: The attack occurred at Horseshoe Reef - north-west of the popular Rottnest Island near the city of Perth, local police say.
